title: Set 277

sentences.ko: 다들 좋다고 계속 얘기하는 에어프라이어 하나 샀는데, 한두 번 썼나 몰라. 조리대를 반이나 차지하고 있어서 토스트 구울 때마다 괜히 샀다 싶어서 좀 짜증 나.
sentences.text: I bought one of those air fryers everybody keeps talking about, and I've used it maybe twice. It takes up half the counter, so every time I make toast I'm kind of annoyed at myself.

alts.text: Got one of those air fryers everyone's always going on about, and I've maybe used it twice. It hogs half the counter, so whenever I make toast I'm kinda mad at myself.

I purchased one of the air fryers that everyone has been talking about, and I have used it perhaps twice. It occupies half of the counter, so each time I make toast I feel somewhat annoyed with myself.

sentences.note: **takes up** 은 자리를 차지한다는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **hogs** 는 혼자 독차지한다는 느낌이 더 강해요.

sentences.ko: 네가 말해 준 태국 음식점 가 봤어. 국수는 네 말이 맞더라, 진짜 맛있었어. 근데 음식이 다 얼마나 매운지는 말 안 해 줬잖아. 두 입째에 벌써 눈물 났어.
sentences.text: We went to that Thai place you told me about. You were right about the noodles, they were amazing, but you didn't mention how spicy everything is. I was crying by the second bite.

alts.text: Tried that Thai place you mentioned. You totally called it on the noodles, they were amazing, but you never said how spicy everything is. Second bite and I was crying.
We visited the Thai restaurant you recommended. You were correct about the noodles; they were excellent. However, you did not mention how spicy everything is. I was in tears by the second bite.

sentences.note: **You were right about** 은 그건 네 말이 맞았다는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **called it** 은 미리 딱 맞혔다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 봄에 이번엔 진짜 배우겠다 싶어서 기타를 샀고, 한 달쯤은 매일 밤 연습했어. 근데 손가락이 아프기 시작하니까 자꾸 미루게 되더라. 지금은 구석에 세워져 있는데 볼 때마다 괜히 찔려.
sentences.text: I bought a guitar back in spring because I was sure I'd finally learn, and I practiced every night for like a month. But then my fingers started hurting, so I kept putting it off, and now it's just sitting in the corner making me feel guilty.

alts.text: Got a guitar in spring, was sure I'd finally learn. Practiced every night for like a month, then my fingers started killing me, so I kept putting it off. Now it just sits there guilt-tripping me.

I purchased a guitar in the spring because I was certain I would finally learn to play, and I practiced every evening for about a month. However, my fingers began to hurt, so I kept postponing my practice, and now the guitar simply sits in the corner and makes me feel guilty.

sentences.note: **kept putting it off** 는 계속 미뤘다는 뜻이에요. **put off** 가 미루다예요.

sentences.ko: 내 폰이 통화하다가 화면이 까맣게 꺼지는 일이 자꾸 생겨. 통화는 계속 연결돼 있는데 말이야. 그래서 내가 끊을 수가 없고, 상대방이 먼저 끊을 때까지 기다려야 돼.
sentences.text: My phone keeps doing this thing where the screen goes black in the middle of a call, but the call's still going. So I can't hang up, and I have to wait for the other person to hang up first.

alts.text: My phone's got this weird thing where the screen just goes black mid-call, but the call's still on. So I can't hang up, I've gotta wait for the other person to do it first.

My phone has a recurring problem in which the screen turns black during a call, although the call continues. As a result, I am unable to hang up and must wait for the other person to end the call first.

sentences.note: **keeps doing this thing where** 는 자꾸 이런 증상이 있다고 말할 때 써요. **hang up** 은 전화를 끊다예요.

sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, 3B호 사는 사람인데요. 일요일부터 난방이 안 돼요. 사람 보내 주신다고 하신 건 아는데 아직 아무도 안 왔어요. 밤에 많이 추워져서 주말 전에 와 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
sentences.text: Hi, it's the guy in 3B. The heat's been out since Sunday, and I know you said you'd send somebody, but nobody's come yet. It's getting really cold at night, so if they could come before the weekend, I'd really appreciate it.

alts.text: Hey, 3B here. Heat's been out since Sunday, and I know you said you'd send someone, but nobody's shown up yet. It's getting really cold at night, so if they could come before the weekend, that'd be awesome.

Hello, this is the tenant in unit 3B. The heating has not been working since Sunday, and I understand you said you would send someone, but no one has arrived yet. It is becoming very cold at night, so I would be most grateful if someone could come before the weekend.

sentences.note: **The heat's been out** 은 난방이 나가서 안 된다는 말이에요. **I'd really appreciate it** 은 정중하게 부탁할 때 써요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

reviewed: 1번 한국어: '한 두 번'을 '한두 번'으로 고치고, '나 자신한테 좀 짜증이 나'는 번역투라 '괜히 샀다 싶어서 좀 짜증 나'로 바꿈
3번 casual: 앞부분 이후가 text와 거의 같아서 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 새로 씀
3번 formal: 'kept postponing it'의 it이 기타인지 연습인지 헷갈려 'kept postponing my practice'로 고침
5번 formal: 'you intended to send someone'은 보내 주겠다고 말했다는 뜻이 약해져 'you said you would send someone'으로 고침
